ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a benzene ring, and on the right side is connected a transition-state structure. The benzene ring has two adjacent substituents: one is connected to the central carbon through an aryl-O bond, and the other is connected to a carbonyl carbon. The central carbon is also connected to an upper R-containing carbon chain, an oxygen bearing H, a lower oxygen, and the lower-left carbonyl carbon; the lower oxygen is further connected to the ester carbonyl on the right, and the right carbonyl is further connected to alkyl-R. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows; the hydrogen-related bond in O-H is not counted. Reasoning count: Count by fragments. There are 6 C-C bonds inside the benzene ring, counted as 6. There are 2 bonds from the benzene ring to the two substituents: aryl-O and aryl-carbonyl carbon, counted as +2. The central/upper part has 6 non-hydrogen bonds: phenoxy O-central carbon, central carbon-upper side-chain carbon, upper side-chain carbon-R, central carbon-OH oxygen, central carbon-lower oxygen, central carbon-lower-left carbonyl carbon, counted as +6. The carbonyl/ester part has 5 non-hydrogen bonds: lower-left C=O, lower oxygen-right carbonyl carbon, right C=O, right carbonyl carbon-alkyl carbon, alkyl carbon-R, counted as +5. The total is 6+2+6+5=19.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count by fragments. First count the benzene ring as 6 C-C bonds. Add the two bonds from the benzene ring to its substituents: aryl-O and aryl-carbonyl carbon, giving +2. Count the central/top portion: phenoxy O-central carbon, central carbon-top side-chain carbon, top side-chain carbon-R, central carbon-OH oxygen excluding the O-H bond, central carbon-lower oxygen, and central carbon-lower-left carbonyl carbon, giving +6. Count the carbonyl/ester portions: lower-left C=O, lower oxygen-right carbonyl carbon, right C=O, right carbonyl carbon-alkyl carbon, and alkyl carbon-R, giving +5. Sum 6+2+6+5 = 19.
